transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and empty for the past eight months, and it has just become too difficult to handle. I feel like I can't find my way out of this constant low mood, so I decided I needed to get some help.

During these past eight months, have you ever experienced periods lasting a few days where your mood was unusually elevated, you had significantly more energy than usual, or you needed much less sleep than normal?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. My mood has been consistently low and depressed for the entire eight months. I definitely haven't had any bursts of energy or periods where I felt elevated.
During these past eight months, have you experienced other symptoms like significant changes in your appetite, sleep patterns, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or sleep patterns. I also haven't experienced issues with my concentration or felt feelings of worthlessness.
Since you have been feeling this low mood for eight months, would you describe it as a constant, low-level sadness, or are there days where you feel significantly worse than others?
It has been a constant, heavy sadness every single day without any relief. There really aren't any better days; the gloomy feeling has just been continuously there for the whole eight months.
During these past eight months, have you had any periods of two months or longer where you felt completely back to your normal self and free of this heavy sadness?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. The heavy sadness and emptiness have been completely continuous without a single day of feeling back to my normal self. It has just been one long, unbroken period of feeling this way.
